user_criterion_verbatim: 跨零不是任何问题，稳健的提升才是，当然至少是2分稳定的

decision_policy.primary_target: At least +2 mIoU percentage points versus stored FoRIS final native at the SAME1024 resolution, with stability across additional121/combined241/folds and not driven by a few cases.
decision_policy.confidence_intervals: Report uncertainty; spanning zero alone is NEVER a rejection or success/failure gate.
decision_policy.stronger_control: RCG and matched mean-control are mandatory comparisons; do NOT redefine user target as RCG+2 without instruction.
decision_policy.stability: Report each cohort/fold/batch and class/episode effect distribution. No newly invented all-fold+2 or CI-sign gate. Judge whether gain repeats and is broadly distributed.

input_cohorts.exposure: All are exposed DEV episodes; additional data available for this fixed validation is not CONF.

arms.name: native_pre
arms.rule: Stored FoRIS pre,1024; verify normalized score bilinearFalse>.5 parity at scoring

arms.name: native_cached_CRF
arms.rule: Stored FoRIS final native/CRF,1024; never substitute pre or original-resolution IU

arms.name: RCG
arms.rule: Uploaded fixedpredict: CSLS foreground guide k10,purity.9,alpha.5,mutualquery20NN localtau,mean-degree1,A=(.1+abs(2s-1))/mean,lambda16;CG1e-7/1e-9/300;bilinearFalse>.5;noCRF

arms.name: MEAN_CONTROL
arms.rule: SameRCG W/A/lambda16;g=q@unit(mean r[sourcecov>=.9]),fallback maxcov;rank correctionalpha.25;identicalrenderer;no retuning

arms.name: source_contrast_mean
arms.rule: Originaleligiblecandcountpositive seed hypotheses,complete .2aggregation; dR=unit(mean r_FG-mean r_onecell4neighborouterring);choose argmax mean(q_H) dot dR;not query-context cosine

arms.name: scalar_contrast
arms.rule: Samecompletehypotheses;choose argmax (mean q_H-mean q_onecell4neighborouterring) dot dR;no normalization by querycontrastnorm;must not promote to primary based on new121

arms.name: foreground_mean_cos/foreground_mean_dot/query_saliency/relative_context_cos
arms.rule: Existing helper definitions unchanged;all computed choices retained but no new winner selection

fallback_and_ties: Preserve existing per-score finite-validity and first argmax order. If no finite score, return original INSID3 default. Missing reference ring does NOT switch to globalBG or RCG. Empty role/bank implementation failures must be recorded before GT, never replaced by a result-based gate.
prediction_contract: No query GT inpredict. New121 complete predictions and choices for all required arms must be hashed/frozen before scoring thiscohort. No alpha/lambda/k/fidelity/sourcepurity/cut/ring/tie/area/selector selection on arriving121.
implementation: Snapshots lock current mathematical rule. Any purely engineering adaptation must reproduce old120 corresponding frozen outputs/IU before new121 GT; record code hashes and discrepancy, no method parameter change.

metric_contract.resolution: 1024x1024 same working raster;classΣI/ΣU then macro mean
metric_contract.primary_contrasts: Each candidate vs native_cached_CRF; separately pre,RCG,MEAN_CONTROL andinsid3_default
metric_contract.cohorts: Always separate prior120/additional121;combined241 reaggregate perclass fromIU,never weighted average cohort mIoU
metric_contract.bootstrap: 2000,np.random.RandomState(0);sortepisodes(fold,e,c);buildconnectedcomponents bysupport/query photobasename;groups orderedbyfirstsortedepisode;sampleGgroupsGtimes;preserve repeated-group weights inI/U;omit unsampledclasses
stability_outputs: per-fold class-macro gain for each cohort
per-upload-part result with n (part12 n1 never treated as fullbatch)
